| The Matlab .mat format stores post processing measurements.  This post processing includes the normalization of the measurements.  The .mat file format includes a single cell with the following variable information.   |
|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|

| .Mat File   |
|-------------|

| Variable Name   | AllthePdps   |
|-----------------|--------------|

| Location         | Title                     | Information contained in the cell location                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
|------------------|---------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| AllthePdps{:,1}  |                           | The Acqusition number                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| AllthePdps{:,2}  |                           | The Record Number                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| AllthePdps{:,3}  |                           | The Acquisition date and time                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| AllthePdps{:,4}  |                           | The record time                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| AllthePdps{:,5}  |                           | The Absolute Time and Date                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| AllthePdps{:,6}  |                           | The Impulse Response (I,Q) data                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| AllthePdps{1,7}  | Name                      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| AllthePdps{1,8}  |                           | The name of the measurement data file                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| AllthePdps{2,7}  | MeasNotes                 |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| AllthePdps{2,8}  |                           | Basic information regarding the measurement data                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| AllthePdps{3,7}  | Pncode File               |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| AllthePdps{3,8}  |                           | The file location for the Pncode file                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| AllthePdps{4,7}  | Data/Time                 |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| AllthePdps{4,8}  |                           | Data and time of the measurement                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| AllthePdps{5,7}  | Carrier Freq              |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| AllthePdps{5,8}  |                           | Carrier Frequency in Hz                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| AllthePdps{6,7}  | Base PN code length       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| AllthePdps{6,8}  |                           | Base PN code length                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| AllthePdps{7,7}  | PN Oversample             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| AllthePdps{7,8}  |                           | PN Oversample                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| AllthePdps{8,7}  | Codeword Length           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| AllthePdps{8,8}  |                           | Codeword length                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| AllthePdps{9,7}  | Acquire Every N Codewords |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| AllthePdps{9,8}  |                           | There are N records in an acquisition or array.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| AllthePdps{10,7} | Acqusitions per file      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| AllthePdps{10,8} |                           | It is the number of Array of N Records in a File.  Files of IQ data are concatenated over a run to generate the complete Impulse Response file.                                                                                                                                        |
| AllthePdps{11,7} | Number of Arrays          |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| AllthePdps{11,8} |                           | Number of Arrays provides the same information as the Acqusitions per file                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| AllthePdps{12,7} | Number of Records         |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| AllthePdps{12,8} |                           | One IQ “codeword” of data. The length of the record is the length of the word*oversampling.                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| AllthePdps{13,7} | Word Length               |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| AllthePdps{13,8} |                           | The word length has the same information as in the Codeword length                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| AllthePdps{14,7} | WF Increment              |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| AllthePdps{14,8} |                           | The time between data points, general 12.5 ns                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| AllthePdps{15,7} | Acqusition Delay (sec)    |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| AllthePdps{15,8} |                           | The program has a delay between listening for and acquiring each record – it is N codewords long (usually 200).  The Acquisition Delay is an additional delay between every array of N records.  The delay is largely to make sure the computer is keeping up with the data streaming. |
| AllthePdps{16,7} | Max VST Input Level (dBm) |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| AllthePdps{16,8} |                           | This is the max power level allowed by the receiver without compression.  This allows for variable setting of the available dynamic range to optimize sensitivity.                                                                                                                     |
| AllthePdps{17,7} | Antenna Gain Notes        |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| AllthePdps{17,8} |                           | This contains the information regarding the antenna gains.  If the frequency is 2 Ghz, the sentence will be Tx Tecom stationary 2.9 dBi, Rx moving -3.84 dBi.  If the frequency is 5 Ghz, the sentence will be Tx Tecom stationary 3.6 dBi, Rx moving -3.26 dBi.                       |
